query: Where can I make free printable Bopomofo flashcards for all 37 Zhuyin symbols?
page_title: Free Printable Bopomofo Flashcards for All 37 Zhuyin Symbols
meta_description: Choose any official Bopomofo symbols and print fixed-order Zhuyin cutting cards without an account, child data, scoring, or live shuffle.
lead: Use the free printable generator to choose all 37 basic Bopomofo symbols, one official category, or an exact custom set. The same selection always returns the same official order, and the page asks for no child information.
detail: The free generator linked above presents the 21 initials, 3 medials, and 13 finals in the order documented by Taiwan's Ministry of Education. Choose 4, 6, or 8 cards per A4 page and whether to show the category label. The tool deliberately omits unverified one-to-one Pinyin and example-word answers: it prints only the official symbol set and links to Ministry of Education and Unicode sources. It does not play or record audio, save selections, score pronunciation, assess readiness, diagnose a learning need, or promise a learning result.
follow_up: Start with the free cards and an official pronunciation source. Lumi Bopomofo is optional if a family later wants guided symbol, sound, tracing, tone, or blending activities; verify the current App Store listing before deciding.

faq.q: Does the generator include all 37 basic Bopomofo symbols?
faq.a: Yes. It includes 21 initials, 3 medials, and 13 finals in the official Ministry of Education order.

faq.q: Does it collect or save information about a child?
faq.a: No. The tool accepts only official symbols and print settings in the current page; it has no child profile, upload, score, or saved result.

faq.q: Do the flashcards grade pronunciation or measure Zhuyin ability?
faq.a: No. They are printable activity cards and do not listen, grade, rank, assess, diagnose, or prove mastery.

faq.q: Is the Lumi Bopomofo app required?
faq.a: No. The printable generator works independently. The app is an optional guided practice layer, and its current App Store listing should be verified before deciding.
